blocks.text: East Central Maple Ridge Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: The Town Centre core in the plan was first described as bounded by Ontario Street (224 Street), Dewdney Trunk Road, Hinch Road (225 Street) and Lougheed Highway, later expanded north to 124 Avenue, west to 221 Street and east to Burnett Street.

The wider detached-house streets run east and north of that core toward 232 Street and 124 Avenue; the City publishes no separate boundary for them, so a listing's "East Central" label is a board label, not a City line.

blocks.text: East Central Maple Ridge Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Detached houses here sit in two settings: older residential streets east and north of downtown, and the denser Town Centre edge where the 2025 plan directs higher-density, mixed-use growth around Haney Place Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station.

The 2025 Town Centre update consolidated land-use designations from 11 to 7 and added a Town Centre Core designation, so a detached house near 224 Street can sit beside land the plan now treats as core, not low-density residential.

Fletcher Park at 12260 Fletcher Street is the named neighbourhood park inside the residential part, listed by the City with open green space, benches, a playground and wheelchair access — a marker for the established-house streets north of downtown.

blocks.text: East Central Maple Ridge Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The Town Centre Area Plan (Official Community Plan s. 10.4), updated November 25, 2025 by Bylaw 8060-2025, is the plan that governs the downtown edge of East Central, including the River Bend addition.

Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station are designated Transit-Oriented Areas under Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024, adopted June 25, 2024 — check a house near 223 Street or River Road against that bylaw, not just its zone.
On Fraser River floodplain lots at the south edge, no habitable floor space may sit below the flood construction level, set at 6.7 metres geodetic (including freeboard) in the City's 2008 study.
Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h) prohibits rental accommodation (suites) on a property situated in the floodplain — a suite that is legal on a 124 Avenue lot may be prohibited on a River Road lot.

blocks.text: East Central Maple Ridge Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Maple Ridge Leisure Centre at 11925 Haney Place is the indoor pool, fitness centre and gymnasium for East Central houses — it is in the downtown core, not a separate neighbourhood facility.
The only Fraser Valley Regional Library branch in Maple Ridge is Maple Ridge Public Library at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, inside this area.

Thomas Haney Secondary at 23000 116 Avenue and ci:tməxw Environmental Community (K–8) at 23125 116 Avenue share the east-side school site; Maple Ridge Secondary at 21911 122 Avenue sits at the west edge, so two East Central addresses can feed different secondaries.

The City mails its "Be Flood Ready" guide to properties near the Fraser River floodplain and states it maintains dikes, pump stations and drainage systems and monitors river levels during freshet — relevant to River Road houses only, not the 124 Avenue streets.

blocks.text: East Central Maple Ridge Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Town Centre Area Plan update — adopted November 25, 2025 (Bylaw 8060-2025): expanded the boundary to include River Bend, consolidated 11 designations to 7, and added the Town Centre Core designation anchored by Haney Place Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station. Status (as of November 3, 2026): adopted.

Fletcher Park Playground Replacement — Fletcher Park, 12260 Fletcher Street: the City's Engage page lists replacement of aging playground structures; status (as of November 3, 2026): listed as a current City project.

Construction at Dewdney Trunk Road and 224 Street — the City's traffic notice (last updated July 20, 2026) states the westbound Dewdney Trunk lane is closed between 222 and 224 Street and 223 Street is fully closed between Dewdney Trunk Road and Brown Avenue due to a development site, with geotechnical work under way; the notice does not name the project. Status (as of November 3, 2026): construction impacts ongoing per City notice.

blocks.text: East Central Maple Ridge Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: The one East Central-specific cost rule confirmed is floodplain construction: houses below the 6.7-metre flood construction level on Fraser River lots face the City's floodplain construction requirements, which affect rebuild and renovation budgets on River Road lots.

blocks.text: East Central Maple Ridge Houses: getting around

items.t: Haney Place Transit Exchange is in this area, and TransLink names these routes from Haney Place: R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus, 701 to Coquitlam Central Station / Maple Ridge East, 733 Rock Ridge, 741 Anderson Creek, 745 Cottonwood and 746 Albion.
West Coast Express at Port Haney Station, 22300 River Road, runs weekdays between Waterfront and Mission City with five trains each way.

Planned Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit is a 22-kilometre, 13-station line between Willowbrook in Langley and Haney Place, with peak service every 10 minutes as planned, connecting at Haney Place to the R3; TransLink lists it in detailed planning with roadway designs, costs and timelines not yet determined.

blocks.text: East Central Maple Ridge Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check any River Road or Port Haney lot on the City's Fraser River floodplain mapping: the flood construction level here is 6.7 metres geodetic and suites are prohibited on floodplain lots under Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h).
The flood and escarpment documents are area-level only — neither tells a buyer the status of one lot.

East Central home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

79 houses sold in East Central with a median price of $1,100,000 (the middle half sold between $975,000 and $1,212,500), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $505 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median lot of 6,372 square feet.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 75 houses listed in East Central. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many houses are for sale in East Central?

faq.a: In October 2026, houses in East Central had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is East Central a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?

faq.a: 49 houses sold in East Central over those 5 months, out of 247 in all of Maple Ridge.
faq.q: How many houses sold in East Central from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in East Central?

faq.a: Only the downtown edge is. The Town Centre Area Plan, updated November 25, 2025, covers the core around 224 Street, Dewdney Trunk Road and Lougheed Highway, expanded to 124 Avenue, 221 Street and Burnett Street. Houses further east toward 232 Street are in the MLS sub-area but outside that plan area, so plan policies on density do not apply the same way.
faq.q: Is my East Central house actually in the Town Centre plan?

faq.a: Catchment is by exact address in School District 42, not by the East Central label. Schools physically in or beside this area include Eric Langton Elementary at 12138 Edge Street, Golden Ears Elementary at 23124 118 Avenue and Harry Hooge Elementary at 12280 230 Street.
faq.q: Which elementary school serves a house on Edge Street or 230 Street?

faq.a: Not if the lot is in the Fraser River floodplain. The City's floodplain document states Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h) prohibits rental accommodation on a floodplain property, and habitable floors must sit at or above the 6.7-metre flood construction level. Check the flood map for the specific River Road or 223 Street address first.
faq.q: Can I add a suite to a house near Port Haney?

faq.a: Port Haney Station at 22300 River Road is the West Coast Express stop for this area. TransLink lists Port Haney on the weekday commuter line between Waterfront in downtown Vancouver and Mission City, with five trains each way on weekdays — westbound in the morning, eastbound in the afternoon and evening. Houses on River Road sit closest to that line.
faq.q: How close is the train, and how often does it run?

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in East Central?
